_doc: Revert-verify for ems__Bug 413f80b9 (ExoSync: exo__Asset_updatedAt changed on both sides keeps the later stamp), subject = StructuredMerger.ts. Axes U*/T* in packages/core/tests/unit/services/sync/StructuredMerger.updatedat.test.ts. The harness runs under TZ=Asia/Almaty so that U13 can tell the production default (device local time) from UTC (M13); the axes themselves are zone-independent. Run: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this spec> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/services/sync/StructuredMerger.ts

M1_rule_never_applies._note: The pre-fix behaviour: the stamp is an ordinary scalar. U6 reddens too, and that is expected: its asset lists the stamp BEFORE ems__Effort_startTimestamp, so without the rule the merge stops at the stamp and the conflict reason names exo__Asset_updatedAt instead of the key U6 asserts.

M3_compared_as_text._note: Lexical order disagrees with time order in U3/U5/U10/U13 (offset/Z/naive mixes); in U4 they happen to agree.

M5_unparseable_treated_as_zero._note: An unparseable stamp read as epoch 0 silently loses to any real stamp instead of conflicting.

M6_offset_sign_ignored._note: Only T1 carries a negative offset.

M9_other_key_conflict_hidden._note: Drops the key-name check: a both-sides change of ANOTHER timestamp-valued key (U6) would be resolved by max instead of conflicting.

M10_calendar_rollover_accepted._note: Without the round-trip check 02-30 rolls over to 03-02, day 32 to the next month, month 13 to next January.
M10_calendar_rollover_accepted.from: if (day.getUTCMonth() !== mo - 1 || day.getUTCDate() !== d) return undefined;

M13_default_mapping_is_utc._note: Red only because the harness runs under TZ=Asia/Almaty: in a UTC runner device-local time IS UTC.
M13_default_mapping_is_utc.from:
t.setFullYear(y, mo, d);
  t.setHours(h, mi, s, ms);
M13_default_mapping_is_utc.to:
t.setUTCFullYear(y, mo, d);
  t.setUTCHours(h, mi, s, ms);

M14_base_judged_by_key_presence._note: Judging 'has a base' by the stamp KEY in the base (review round 1 LOW-3) leaves a base without a stamp conflicting.
